title: Minecraft Bedrock 26.60 support
summary: Join Cookie Build with Minecraft Bedrock 26.60 using the same server address and port.
body:
- Updated Bedrock connectivity to Geyser 2.12.1 build 1276 for Minecraft Bedrock 26.60.
- Enabled NetherNet, the connection method required by Bedrock 26.60, while keeping RakNet available for supported older clients.
- Keep using play.cookie-build.com with port 19132. Bedrock may ask you to trust the server on your first connection with the new transport.
- Java access, worlds, player progress and gameplay rules remain unchanged.
